description: Per-sensor calibration keyed by sensor_id (the dome map's positions name the sensor mounted there). deg_per_mv: (dA, dB) mV after tare -> (theta_e1, theta_e2) deg, [[a, b], [c, d]] or [gA, gB]; optional date, source, note. Sensors with no entry use the placeholder gain. Example entry: "S07": {"deg_per_mv": [1.0, 1.0], "date": "2026-11-02", "source": "gantry sweep run 12"}
